description: Lists the social accounts connected to the workspace, with health, how many posts are queued on each, and the effective limits for that account. Use this to pick the accounts for create_post and schedule_post, or to check whether an account needs reconnecting. Returns accounts[] (id, ref, platform, username, health, scheduledCount, limits, blockedByPlan, and seo for WordPress accounts), nextCursor and hasMore. seo is "yoast" when the WordPress site lets this account write Yoast SEO fields (schedule_post wordpress.seo), and "core" when it does not. health.status is the same as the dashboard: an expired access token that renews itself is still active; only needs_reconnect means the user must reconnect. ref is the account as "platform:handle" (e.g. "x:acme_studio"): pass it wherever a tool takes an account, since it is what the person reads when approving; it is null when the account has no handle, and then the id is used. Does NOT connect or disconnect accounts; that happens in the dashboard.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

groupId.description: Only accounts in this channel group.

name: list_accounts

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there is none.
